channel.title: Foro de Teresina — Week-of-Year Order
channel.description: Unofficial personal re-ordering of the Foro de Teresina podcast archive: episodes grouped by calendar week-of-year, oldest year first within each week, so you can listen to "this week in past years" episodes together. Audio is streamed from the original publisher's hosting; nothing is re-hosted here.
channel.itunes:author: piauí
